Yes, it's often a problem with AI images, because about 3000 is made for each image. Therefore they are small so the machine doesn't crash.

Last week, however, copyright was lifted on the newest model - DALLE-2 - and that one can make heavy images. So I have sent two new ones with wetransfer. I just made those because my other experiments with it have gone in other directions - but I suppose they can work very well?

One of Computer Lars, and one of Christiansborg.
